findings.title: B skipped IC assigned_etf even with positive ordinary target
findings.trigger: mode=B, product=IC, next route=assigned_etf, ordinary core delta>0
findings.initial_behavior: The eligible expression required mode C for assigned_etf; result was no recovery insurance.
findings.spec: B/C both cover IC assigned_etf and recovery_future.
findings.status: reported_to_root; condition corrected on reread; independent execution pending

findings.title: IC monthly preview and reference day could both refresh insurance
findings.trigger: Saved targets for 2025-01-16 and 2025-01-17 both monthly_reset_due=True with reference_day=2025-01-17; a held C recovery sleeve is present.
findings.initial_behavior: Both signals would trigger a new selection/scale on 2025-01-17 and 2025-01-20 open.
findings.spec: One monthly insurance maintenance event, T selection/T+1 open.
findings.status: reported_to_root; reference_day==T condition corrected on reread; independent execution pending

findings.title: Fresh recovery insurance could inherit ordinary no-seller sleeve old contract
findings.trigger: B, or C whose ordinary base is already positive; enter a protected state with valid unexpired target.core_put_contract_target selected at an earlier ordinary month.
findings.initial_behavior: Existing base_contract/base_qty accepted without invoking the T-date fresh selector. C minimum-only case used fresh selector, so arms were asymmetric.
findings.spec: Recovery insurance is an independent sleeve; fresh entry selects IC95%/IM102% near T+3m using T inputs.
findings.status: reported_to_root; awaiting implementation resolution and stable notice

accounting_read_checks.premium: Account.trade adjusts cash and option asset symmetrically; equity_change is fee only. Subsequent mark/settlement contributes economic option PnL once.
accounting_read_checks.assignment: Account.assign_short_put marks seller at intrinsic, replaces liability with ETF and strike cash outflow at unchanged equity; subsequent ETF mark captures the held-share exposure.
accounting_read_checks.cash_wait: Controller observes no invented spot return; independent momentum/grid/cash-interest symbols are excluded.
accounting_read_checks.cycle_boundary: consume starts before switch trades but after the prior ordinary exposure opening marks; after_open_trades observes insurance exit/gap before closing cycle.
accounting_read_checks.exit_fee: close subtracts current insurance sale fee at T; T+1 actual fills remain in cycle.
accounting_read_checks.remaining_qualification: future|core| switch fees at start/restart are included by symbol category; ordinary core Put switch events excluded. Report this attribution boundary consistently and do not call cycle PnL total account PnL.
